summary: STMicroelectronics filed a Form 6-K enclosing an October 13, 2026 press release announcing that its Supervisory Board has asked President and CEO Jean-Marc Chery to stand for reappointment to a further one-year term, which he accepted. Shareholders will vote on the reappointment, including his role as Chairman of the Managing Board, at the 2027 Annual General Meeting. The filing documents an orderly, planned leadership continuity decision rather than a forced or abrupt departure, so it is not classified as a special-situation management change; no deal terms, advisors or regulatory clock are stated. Watch for AGM opposition or proxy-advisor dissent.
